integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the equivalence-relation EF profile and solves the truncated-count uniqueness problem as a path of tight, exact, and slack constraints. Finite verification corroborates both reductions but is not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary first-order logic only; finite nonempty complete multipartite graphs; the exact answer is a linear-time path criterion rather than a closed scalar expression for every heterogeneous multiset. Priority risk from unindexed folklore remains.
title: Exact logical depth of complete multipartite graphs via a threshold path
